newsitem.title: USA: PhoneTel extends tender offer again.
newsitem.headline: PhoneTel extends tender offer again.

text.p: PhoneTel Technologies Inc said Monday that it will extend its cash tender offer for shares of Communications Central Inc to 0000 EDT/ 0400 GMT August 20.

It is the third extension of the offer to buy Communications Central since the offer was announced in March. PhoneTel said then it would buy the company for $12.85 a share, or a total of about $165 million.

PhoneTel said both companies were evaluating the impact of a recent court ruling and FCC decision concerning compensation for payhphone providers, and may restructure the deal in light of those decisions.
Both companies are independent pay-phone operators.
